This section holds a certificate for the direction of a comparison under an incomplete gold, its derivation, its registered tests on the human-completed gold of XM3600-600, a development check on COCO-5000 and a post hoc application to published comparisons. By the entry rule fixed before the results (Section 6.7), the certificate was not validated, so it is reported here and not in the main text. The human-completed gold itself, H1, H3 and the per-system intervals are in Section 6.7.
S11.2 (registered sketch restated; no fuller derivation exists)

The budget $\beta$ and the secondary Hoeffding budget $\beta_H$ are defined, with the assumptions under which the budget holds and the sketch of its derivation, in Supplementary S11.1 ("What the floor means, and what is proved under it"). The registration states that sketch and no fuller derivation: for a present pair named by $N$ of $k$ references, $P(N=0)/P(N=1) = (1-w_{ic})/(k\,w_{ic}) \le c_w$; summing over the pairs of the cell and applying Bernstein's inequality twice, each step at level $\alpha_S/2$, gives $P\big(x(\mathcal C) > \beta(\mathcal C; w)\big) \le \alpha_S$. The derivation has had no external proof review (Section 9.1).
S11.3 (the registered §V.4/§V.4a identity in the paper's notation)

With a gold built from references only, no pair is known absent, so every mention of a system is known present or unknown: $t_A + u(\mathcal C_{A\setminus B}) + u(\mathcal C_{A\cap B}) = n_A$, and likewise for $B$. At $w = 0$ the cap is $X = u$. At the worst-case completion, $x(\mathcal C_{B\setminus A}) = u(\mathcal C_{B\setminus A})$ and $x(\mathcal C_{A\cap B}) = u(\mathcal C_{A\cap B})\,\mathbf 1[n_A > n_B]$. If $n_A > n_B$, $\Delta_{\min} = (t_A + u(\mathcal C_{A\cap B}))/n_A - 1 \le 0$; otherwise $\Delta_{\min} = t_A/n_A - 1 + u(\mathcal C_{A\cap B})/n_B \le u(\mathcal C_{A\cap B})(1/n_B - 1/n_A) \le 0$. So the reference-only certificate at $w = 0$ certifies no precision order. It certifies no slope sign either: the completion that sets every unknown pair present gives precision 1 to each system, a point inside the corner box of the slope interval with slope 0. The high end of every per-system interval at $w = 0$ is therefore 1 (Table 6.7d). All content of the reference-only certificate lies in the floor; the no-assumption certificate has content only when the gold has known-absent pairs, as the label side has.

The labelling page and its build script are in `tools/obj_rater/` of the code record; the build script fixes the questions, the hidden controls and their order with seed 20261111. A mapped class is shown with the Open Images classes it maps to ("Open Images: …"), and the annotator is told to read the class by them; a class without a mapping (part 2) is shown by its lexicon word alone. The four answers are shown in Vietnamese: Có (yes), Không (no), Không xác định được (U: the image cannot settle it) and Tên lớp mơ hồ (A: the word does not name an object category). Practice used 15 XM3600 images outside the 600, with Open Images answers and feedback; practice answers are not data. Every answer is appended to a file, one line per answer; a changed answer is a new line, the last line of a question is its answer, and all lines are kept. During labelling the analysts read only the line count and the SHA-256 of that file, which the project log records at the end of each session; the file that holds the role of each question is kept by the analysis pipeline, is not served to the page and was not opened by the annotator. The roles were read only by the pinned scoring script.
